messages.subject: seqfault error: pointer being freed was not allocated
parts:
Hi - I can't track down why my program is give me a segfault error. Unfortunately I can't even really debug because R shuts down..... has anyone seen this error before?  and can someone direct how to "set a breakpoint in malloc_error_break" ?

 *** caught segfault ***
address 0x0, cause 'unknown'
R(1256,0x7fff7cf71310) malloc: *** error for object 0x7fd4e62b8ca0: pointer being freed was not allocated
*** set a breakpoint in malloc_error_break to debug

however, sometimes I just get
 *** caught segfault ***
address 0x0, cause 'unknown'

a working example can be downloaded here.
